ETS‑Lindgren to Showcase Innovative Solutions at 2025 Tabletop Shows
 April 3, 2025
CEDAR PARK, Texas, April 3, 2025 – ETS‑Lindgren, the global leader in Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) and Radio Frequency (RF) Measurement Solutions, is pleased to announce its participation in two upcoming industry tabletop events: the IEEE EMC MiniSymposium and EMC Fest 2025.
The IEEE EMC MiniSymposium, hosted by the IEEE EMC Society Chicago Chapter, will take place on Tuesday, May 6, in Schaumburg, Illinois, and will provide a valuable opportunity for industry professionals to learn about the latest developments in EMC technology. ETS‑Lindgren will be onsite to share insights and demonstrate solutions designed to support EMC test and measurement applications with its Test and Measurement Solutions Full Line Brochure. Attendees will also have the opportunity to see ETS‑Lindgren’s EMC-24PCL absorber, featuring FlexSorb™ technology, a specialized coating designed to enhance absorber performance and durability for consistent EMC testing results.
The IEEE EMC Society Southeastern Michigan Chapter’s EMC Fest 2025 will be held on Thursday, May 8, in Livonia, Michigan. ETS‑Lindgren will showcase its Top 10 Considerations for Automotive EMC Chamber Design and Testing Brochure, along with its full line of Test and Measurement Solutions. These resources highlight the company’s expertise in automotive EMC testing, providing industry professionals with guidance on designing chambers and improving test efficiency.
“We look forward to participating in the IEEE EMC MiniSymposium and EMC Fest 2025, where we will have the opportunity to connect with industry professionals and share practical solutions for EMC challenges,” said Kevin Baldwin, Director of Regional Sales with ETS‑Lindgren. “These events provide an excellent platform for discussing the latest advancements in EMC technology and supporting the efforts of the IEEE EMC Society Chicago and Southeastern Michigan Chapters.”
Participants at both events are encouraged to visit the ETS‑Lindgren tabletop displays to learn more about the company’s solutions and speak with its team of experts.
About ETS‑Lindgren
ETS‑Lindgren is an international manufacturer of components and systems that measure, shield, and control electromagnetic and acoustic energy. The company’s products are used for electromagnetic compatibility (EMC), microwave, wireless, and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) testing, electromagnetic field (EMF) measurement, radio frequency (RF) personal safety monitoring, and control of acoustic environments.
Headquartered in Cedar Park, Texas, ETS‑Lindgren has manufacturing facilities in North America, Europe, and Asia. The company is a wholly owned subsidiary of ESCO Technologies, a leading supplier of engineered products for growing industrial and commercial markets. ESCO is a New York Stock Exchange listed company (symbol ESE) with headquarters in St. Louis, Missouri. Additional information about ETS‑Lindgren is available atwww.ets-lindgren.com. Follow ETS‑Lindgren onFacebook,Instagram,LinkedIn,X, andYouTube. Additional information about ESCO and its subsidiaries is available atwww.escotechnologies.com.

 Solutions 
ETS‑Lindgren delivers industry-leading solutions for EMC and RF testing, shielding, and calibration—empowering critical sectors like aerospace, healthcare, communications, and utilities to achieve compliance, protect infrastructure, and optimize performance through innovative, turnkey systems and technologies.
ETS‑Lindgren offers comprehensive solutions in electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) and RF shielding that serve a wide range of industries including aerospace, healthcare, automotive, and communications. These solutions feature custom-designed anechoic chambers, RF-shielded enclosures, absorber materials, and advanced positioning systems that create controlled environments for precise testing, product development, and regulatory compliance.
In addition to testing environments, ETS‑Lindgren provides specialized shielding technologies to protect critical infrastructure from electromagnetic threats such as EMP and HEMP. ETS‑Lindgren also delivers turnkey systems, expert calibration, and support services. For healthcare, ETS‑Lindgren designs MRI shielding and RF-shielded solutions, enabling medical facilities to maintain safe, interference-free settings essential for accurate diagnostics and medical device validation.

 Critical Infrastructure / HEMP, EMP & IEMI 
ETS‑Lindgren delivers advanced shielding solutions—including the proprietary Red Edge™ technology—to protect critical infrastructure from HEMP, EMP, and IEMI threats, ensuring secure, interference-free operation of mission-critical systems across defense, telecommunications, and energy sectors.
ETS‑Lindgren provides advanced shielding solutions for critical infrastructure, specifically targeting High-altitude Electromagnetic Pulses (HEMP), Electromagnetic Pulses (EMP), and Intentional Electromagnetic Interference (IEMI). These technologies are designed to protect sensitive systems and assets from the potentially devastating effects of electromagnetic threats, which can compromise the functionality of electronic equipment and disrupt critical operations. ETS‑Lindgren’s solutions encompass a range of shielding systems, including custom-designed enclosures, doors, windows, and barriers, which ensure a secure and interference-free environment for critical infrastructure.
Our RedEdge technology is an innovative solution designed to address the challenges of electromagnetic threats. RedEdge technology provides superior shielding performance, offering robust protection against HEMP, EMP, and IEMI events. The technology is engineered to safeguard communications, command, control, and defense systems, as well as power grids and other mission-critical infrastructure. By leveraging advanced materials and innovative design, RedEdge ensures maximum reliability and operational continuity in environments that are vulnerable to these disruptive forces.
Together with our comprehensive shielding solutions, ETS‑Lindgren offers tailored approaches to meet the specific needs of various industries, including defense, telecommunications, and energy sectors. These solutions are engineered to preserve the integrity of critical infrastructure by mitigating the impact of electromagnetic interference. ETS‑Lindgren’s HEMP, EMP, and IEMI shielding technologies, supported by RedEdge, ensure that essential systems remain functional and protected, even in the face of increasingly sophisticated electromagnetic threats.

 Data Centers 
Mission-critical data centers must remain operational during electromagnetic events. ETS‑Lindgren delivers hardened enclosures, filtering, and validation systems that protect servers, networks, and storage from destructive RF and transient energy.
At ETS‑Lindgren, we provide a comprehensive suite of shielding solutions designed to meet the unique challenges faced by data centers, particularly those needing protection from HEMP, EMP, and IEMI threats. As critical infrastructures, data centers must safeguard their sensitive equipment and data from the potentially devastating effects of electromagnetic disturbances. Our shielding solutions are specifically engineered to meet these demands, offering both broad and targeted protection across all aspects of a data center’s operations.
Our advanced facility filters are a key part of this offering, designed to block harmful electromagnetic interference (EMI) from entering the facility and affecting critical systems. These filters help ensure that external electrical events, such as surges from EMP or IEMI, do not compromise the integrity of sensitive equipment or disrupt operations. By integrating these filters into the building’s electrical infrastructure, we ensure that data flows securely, preventing downtime and safeguarding data integrity.
For more localized protection, ETS‑Lindgren offers small rackmount enclosures that provide an additional layer of defense at the equipment level. These enclosures shield individual servers, networking devices, and other sensitive equipment from electromagnetic threats while ensuring that airflow and cooling requirements are not compromised. This localized protection helps maintain optimal performance of equipment in high-risk environments without sacrificing system efficiency.
RedEdge technology, another key component of our solutions, provides next-generation shielding that enhances the overall protection of data centers. By integrating advanced electromagnetic shielding into the facility’s infrastructure, RedEdge allows for superior resilience against all forms of EMI, ensuring that data centers can continue to operate without disruption, even in the face of electromagnetic threats. Together, these solutions work seamlessly to deliver an all-encompassing defense system that keeps data centers secure, resilient, and operational, no matter the electromagnetic challenges they may face.

 Communications 
Critical communications infrastructure must survive extreme electromagnetic environments. ETS‑Lindgren provides hardened RF shielding and test solutions that protect radio, satellite, and command-and-control systems from HEMP, EMP, and IEMI threats.
At ETS‑Lindgren, we pride ourselves on offering a comprehensive and customizable range of shielding solutions that are specifically designed to meet the needs of communication applications, especially in environments vulnerable to HEMP, EMP, and IEMI threats. These advanced solutions provide a critical layer of protection to safeguard communication systems from the potentially disruptive effects of electromagnetic events. Our facility filters are integral to blocking unwanted electromagnetic interference (EMI), ensuring that sensitive communication signals remain unaffected by external disturbances. By preventing electromagnetic noise from infiltrating communication networks, we help maintain the reliability and integrity of systems that are essential for everyday operations and national security.
In addition to our facility filters, we provide small rackmount enclosures that offer localized shielding for sensitive communication equipment. These enclosures are ideal for protecting individual devices or small-scale communication systems from localized electromagnetic disturbances. They are designed with the flexibility to fit into existing infrastructure while maintaining efficient system operation. These enclosures help preserve the functional integrity of devices without adding unnecessary complexity or taking up valuable space. For larger-scale protection, we offer extensive shielding solutions that cover entire communication infrastructures, ensuring that critical systems are shielded from any external EMI or disruption. These solutions can be tailored to fit the specific needs of any facility, offering comprehensive defense against a range of electromagnetic threats.
Moreover, ETS‑Lindgren’s RedEdge technology provides next-generation shielding capabilities that further enhance our communication solutions. RedEdge incorporates cutting-edge materials and design techniques, allowing for superior performance in blocking harmful electromagnetic radiation. This technology helps bolster resilience against electromagnetic risks, ensuring that communication systems remain operational even in the face of severe electromagnetic events. When combined with our facility filters, rackmount enclosures, and large-scale shielding solutions, RedEdge technology delivers a robust, all-encompassing defense that ensures communication systems are secure, reliable, and capable of functioning without disruption, regardless of external electromagnetic conditions. Together, these solutions provide unmatched protection, giving organizations peace of mind in knowing that their communication infrastructure is resilient and secure.
